articles.title: Roman’s guidance tests and first coronagraph images mark a preparation milestone
articles.summary: NASA’s Roman telescope demonstrated extremely steady pointing and collected its first coronagraph images of stars. The observations checked focus and direction as engineers prepare the instrument for increasingly complex tests.

articles.title: A fresh look at Australian stick insects reveals overlooked species
articles.summary: A University of Sydney study revised Australian Anchiale stick insects from two recognized species to five. DNA, museum specimens and public observations helped reveal identities that had been overlooked for decades.

articles.title: Magnetic fossils suggest an ancient creature could navigate 97 million years ago
articles.summary: Three-dimensional imaging revealed magnetic structures suited to sensing Earth’s field inside 97-million-year-old fossils. Researchers suggest they supported navigation, although the organism that made them remains unidentified.
